Harper (sec): quick FYI - staging canary failing at image signing after last nights RBAC tighten. Logging here so infra/runtime can coordinate.
Liam (eng-infra): can you paste the error?
Harper (sec): cosign: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = request missing permission kms.cryptoKeys.encrypt
kms-guard: [automated] 2 KMS_DENIED events for key projects/redwood-staging/locations/global/keyRings/repo/cryptoKeys/staging-sign. Callers: ci-builder-sa, smoke-runner.
Liam (eng-infra): looks like the infra PR removed the key-scoped binding for ci-builder-sa. I'll reapply scoped roles to the cryptoKey and annotate as "temp:unblock-staging". Won't do project-level grant.
Zoe (eng-runtime): please scope it and add annotation canary=true in the canary job so traces are isolated. Also add a CI preflight script to verify key IAM before signing.
Liam (eng-infra): applied binding at 1719999999; PR note: "temporary scoped grant to restore staging signing. follow-up: automate ephemeral grants and safety checks in rotation script."
kms-guard: [automated] IAM update recorded and forwarded to SIEM at 1719999999.
Zoe (eng-runtime): re-ran canary -> cosign: signature upload OK. Runtime accepted image.
Harper (sec): follow-ups: 1) preflight script in CI (fail fast), 2) add dry-run safety to rotation tooling, 3) ticket for ephemeral grant automation, 4) alert: >1 KMS_DENIED in 15m -> notify #eng-security. No customer impact. Closing when PRs merged. :white_check_mark:
